Romanian politician Calin Georgescu tells Tucker Carlson that Antony Blinken and Emmanuel Macron killed Romanian democracy. Georgescu won the first round of Romania's presidential vote before courts annulled the result and barred him. He presents himself as a banned opposition leader robbed of an election.

Georgescu lays out his charge that Western officials pushed Romania to cancel the people's choice. He describes the legal moves used against his campaign. Carlson asks what the case means for democracy across Europe. Concerned and freedom-minded viewers get a stolen-vote claim from the man at its center.
